title: British Summertime
overview: The great ‘British summer’ is a fleeting affair; it’s over before it even begins. But much like anything that alludes us, the magic of its temporariness persists and gives both hope, opportunity and nostalgia. For Tiny and Charlotte in British Summertime, this is the prevailing notion - that the chance they’ve been able to meet and connect is something truly special but it certainly won’t last forever.
